spec.description: A Minecraft server through WorldAPI and minecraft-exporter: performance, worlds, players, activity, chat, and events.

spec.title: TPS
spec.description: Ticks per second over one, five, and fifteen minutes; 20 is full speed.

spec.title: Tick time
spec.description: How long ticks take: the median, the slow ones, and the slowest. Past 50 ms (the red line) the server can't keep 20 TPS.

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: CPU in use across every core: the server's process, and the whole machine.

spec.title: Garbage collection
spec.description: Share of time each collector spends collecting. A few percent is normal; long pauses show up as tick spikes.

spec.title: Load average
spec.description: Processes running or waiting for a CPU. Above the CPU count (dashed), work queues up.

spec.title: Host memory
spec.description: Memory in use on the machine, and how much of it the server's process holds.

spec.title: Disk free
spec.description: Free space on the disk under the server folder, where the world grows.

spec.title: Status
spec.description: Whether the exporter reached WorldAPI on its last scrape, and whether a singleplayer game is paused.

spec.title: Open files
spec.description: Files and sockets the server holds open, against its limit.

spec.title: Entities
spec.description: Mobs, items, minecarts, and everything else that moves, in loaded chunks.

spec.title: Block entities
spec.description: Chests, hoppers, furnaces, and other blocks that keep data, in loaded chunks. Hoppers in bulk cost ticks.

spec.title: Most common entities
spec.description: Across every world, now. Dropped items or one mob type piling up usually means a farm or a lag source.

spec.title: Weather
spec.description: Clear, rain, or a thunderstorm in each world that has weather. Rain turns to snow in cold biomes.

spec.title: Day
spec.description: Days the overworld has lived.

spec.title: Items on the ground
spec.description: Dropped items, stacks added up. Thousands usually mean a farm without a collector.

spec.title: Villagers
spec.description: Villagers in loaded chunks. Trading halls and breeders cost ticks.

spec.title: Pets and named mobs
spec.description: Tamed animals and mobs with a name tag, which never despawn.

spec.title: Busiest chunks
spec.description: The chunks with the most entities in each world, now. The coordinates are chunk coordinates: multiply by 16 for blocks.

spec.title: Ping
spec.description: Each online player's ping, as the server measures it.

spec.title: Online now
spec.description: Who's online now, where, and how they're doing. Coordinates show only with a WorldAPI token, or when WorldAPI shows them to everyone.

spec.expr: max by (player) (clamp_min(minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} - (minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} offset $__range or minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} * 0), 0)) and on (player) minecraft_player_info{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}
max by (player) (minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}) and on (player) minecraft_player_info{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}
max by (player) (minecraft_player_deaths_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}) and on (player) minecraft_player_info{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}
max by (player) (minecraft_player_advancements{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}) and on (player) minecraft_player_info{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"}

spec.title: Played in this period
spec.description: Time each player spent online within the dashboard's time range.

spec.expr: sort_desc(max by (player) (clamp_min(minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} - (minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} offset $__range or minecraft_player_play_time_seconds_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} * 0), 0)) > 0)

spec.title: Every player
spec.description: Lifetime statistics from the game's own counters. Mined counts every block, Hearts lost the damage taken. Click a header to sort.

spec.title: TPS
spec.description: Ticks per second over the last minute; 20 is full speed. A paused singleplayer game doesn't tick, and Status says so.

spec.title: Joins, deaths, advancements
spec.description: Each bar counts its slice of time.

spec.title: Deaths by cause
spec.description: Within the time range; a killer shows next to the cause when there was one.

spec.title: Mobs killed
spec.description: By player; each bar counts its slice of time.

spec.title: Blocks mined
spec.description: By player; each bar counts its slice of time.

spec.title: Distance traveled
spec.description: By player; each bar counts its slice of time.

spec.title: Other plugins' events
spec.description: Events other plugins share through WorldAPI and record: boss kills, level-ups, and the like. Each bar counts its slice of time.

spec.title: Chat by player
spec.description: Messages each player sent within the time range. Needs a WorldAPI token with chat:read.

spec.expr: sort_desc(sum by (player) (clamp_min(minecraft_player_chat_messages_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} - (minecraft_player_chat_messages_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} offset $__range or minecraft_player_chat_messages_total{instance="$instance", player=~"$player"} * 0), 0)) > 0)

spec.title: New players
spec.description: Players who joined for the first time; each bar counts its slice of time.

spec.title: Tick time p95
spec.description: 95% of recent ticks took less. Past 50 ms the server falls behind.

spec.title: Plugins and mods
spec.description: Plugins on the server, or mods on Fabric and NeoForge, with their versions. Needs a WorldAPI token with server:read.

spec.title: Console lines
spec.description: Lines the console printed, by level; each bar counts its slice of time.

spec.title: Warnings and errors by source
spec.description: Who logged warnings and errors within the time range: a plugin, Minecraft, or a library.

spec.title: Heap
spec.description: Java heap in use, of its maximum. It saws up and down with garbage collection.

spec.title: Chat
spec.description: Chat messages within the time range, newest first. WorldAPI records them only with events.chat on, and shows them only to tokens with chat:read.

spec.title: Events
spec.description: Joins, deaths, advancements, and other moments within the time range, newest first.

spec.title: Console warnings and errors
spec.description: The newest warnings and errors the console printed since the server started. Needs a WorldAPI token with logs:read.

spec.title: Collections
spec.description: Garbage collections per minute, by collector.

spec.title: Scrape time
spec.description: How long the exporter took to read WorldAPI, a few player statistics included each time.

spec.title: Failed requests
spec.description: WorldAPI requests that failed, by endpoint: timeouts, errors, a server that's down. Missing permissions don't count; the table beside shows them.

spec.title: What the token can read
spec.description: Each WorldAPI endpoint the exporter uses, and whether its token may read it. Panels that need a closed endpoint stay empty.

spec.title: Time of day
spec.description: In the overworld, by the game's clock: a day lasts 20 minutes.

spec.title: Weather now
spec.description: The overworld's weather at the last scrape.

spec.title: Game
spec.description: Whether the game runs or sits paused in its menu; a paused world doesn't tick.

spec.title: Play time
spec.description: Time played in this world.

spec.title: Level
spec.description: The experience level now.

spec.title: Deaths
spec.description: Deaths in this world.

spec.title: Version
spec.description: The server software (Paper, Fabric, or NeoForge), and the WorldAPI version, platform, and side in the tooltip's labels.

spec.title: Diamonds mined
spec.description: Diamond ore mined, deepslate too.

spec.title: Advancements
spec.description: Advancements done, recipes aside.

spec.title: Health and food
spec.description: Health and food points, 20 each when full, while you play.

spec.title: Mods
spec.description: Mods in the game with their versions. Needs a WorldAPI token with server:read.

spec.title: Players ever
spec.description: Everyone who has joined the server at least once.

spec.title: Minecraft server (minecraft-exporter)

spec.name: worldapi
spec.label: WorldAPI
spec.description: An Infinity data source whose URL is your WorldAPI, for the chat and event tables

spec.name: side
spec.label: Side
spec.description: Hidden: integrated for a singleplayer world, where the server's rows hide and “Your world” shows.
